title: Jonah and the Ghost
author: Sable Eriksen
blurb: August Ishikawa, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
